pages.title: Açailândia
pages.extract: Açailândia is a city of 113,000 people (2020) in Maranhão, on the intersection of the Belém-Brasília highway and the São Luís-Parauapebas railway.

pages.title: Anantnag
pages.extract: Anantnag is a city in India, and the second largest city in the Kashmir Valley. Its district headquarters has the largest number of tourist spots in the Kashmir valley.

pages.title: Colorado City
pages.description: town in Mohave County, Arizona, United States
pages.extract:
Colorado City is a city of 4,900 people (2018) straddling the Utah/Arizona border, although most of the city is on the Arizona side. The Utah portion is known as Hildale.
Colorado City is the largest and best-known polygamist community in the United States, and there are few facilities for travelers.

pages.title: Iojima
pages.extract:
There are several places in Japan called Iojima or Iwo Jima:

Iojima in the Ogasawara Islands south of Tokyo, famous for the Battle of Iwo Jima during World War II, very remote and off limits to casual tourism
Iojima in the Mishima Islands south of Kagoshima, a hot spring spot with an active volcano

pages.title: Puyallup
pages.description: city in Pierce County, Washington, United States
pages.extract: Puyallup is a suburban community of 42,000 people (2022) in the south Puget Sound region of Washington state. Puyallup is home to the Washington State Fair, the state's largest fair.

pages.title: South West (Scotland)
pages.extract: South West Scotland is a lowland region of Scotland, a triangle bounded to the west by the Firth of Clyde and to the south by the Solway Firth. It's mostly rural, but with a strip of resort towns along the Clyde coast and industry inland.

pages.title: Troon
pages.description: town in South Ayrshire, Scotland, UK
pages.extract: Troon is a seaside town in Ayrshire in southwest Scotland, with a population of 14,950 in 2020. It's about 40 miles from Glasgow so it's one of the closest beach resorts to the city, and is crowded on fine summer weekends. Another major attraction is golf, best known being the Royal Troon Golf Club which regularly hosts the Open. Troon is also a transport hub and base for exploring the rest of Ayrshire, including the islands of Arran and Great Cumbrae.

pages.title: Ruzhou
pages.extract:
Ruzhou is a county-level city in West Henan, managed by Pingdingshan City. It is named after the North Ruhe River, which runs through it. 
As a colorful pottery jar with storks, fish, stone axes, and painted pottery, it possesses the "Three Treasures of Ruzhou" (Ru porcelain, "Ru Tie", and plum blossom jade), and Ru porcelain is the top of the five famous porcelains of the Song Dynasty. Ru porcelain town has also promoted the integration of traditional culture and modern tourism.
